name: TCL Smart TV Pro · Android 12 · Amlogic · ~2 GB RAM · Stremio with ExoPlayer
about: How well a stream should play on one TV. Every rule is a cap: a stream gets 5 stars minus nothing,
and each property it has limits it to at most `cap` stars. The lowest cap wins; `why` is what the TV
shows. {n} in a `why` is replaced by the number the rule measured. Anything not listed is fine.
To adapt this to another TV, put only the rules that differ in ~/.stremio-local-addon/device-profile.json,
e.g. {"audio": {"truehd": null}} for a TV that decodes TrueHD. Objects merge; lists replace.
Learned on this TV in Oct 2026: DV profile 8 plays in ExoPlayer (OMX.amlogic.dolby-vision.dvhe decoder);
TrueHD crashed ExoPlayer; a DV P7 + DTS-HD MA remux failed; mpv draws green stripes (use ExoPlayer).

mp4.why: MP4 — plays, but embedded subtitles may be hidden

mp4-subs-hidden.why: embedded subtitles hidden (stored away from the video)

avi.why: AVI — old container, seeking can be slow

5.why: Dolby Vision profile 5 — untested on this TV

7.why: Dolby Vision profile 7 (Blu-ray) — fails on this TV

unknown.why: Dolby Vision profile unknown (may be profile 5)

truehd.why: TrueHD audio — this TV can't decode it

dts-hd.why: DTS-HD MA audio — this TV can't decode it

dts.why: DTS audio — untested on this TV

pcm.why: PCM audio — untested on this TV

unknown.why: audio codec not in the release name

mixed.why: {n} track may play first — this TV can't decode it

bitrate.why: {n} Mbps — too heavy to stream over Wi-Fi
